annotations.title: Rents awarded on state-owned property (tender and allocation results)

description: Use this when a user asks what rent was awarded, per month, for leasing state-owned land or buildings (a childcare centre, student hostel, school, office, storage or nursery site) through a government tender, direct allocation or auction, in Singapore state property (country SG). Returns the median monthly rent contracted for the first lease term, a typical range (10th-90th percentile), the number of awards, the period covered, a confidence label, and the official source and licence. These are contract rents from award results (winning bids), not market rents, not asking rents and not home rents; the winning bidder is never shown. How fresh: updated when SLA publishes new results (the file read 29 Oct 2026 ran to award year 2025). Do not use for home rents, rents of private commercial property, sale prices, or a quote for one particular site, or for countries that are not listed.

allocation.description: How the site was allocated: tender (default mix), direct = direct allocation, auction. Leave out for all. Singapore: tender, direct (direct allocation) or auction. Leave out for all.

country.description: SG = Singapore (Singapore Land Authority rent awards on state land and buildings, SGD a month, award years 2004 to 2025)

use.description: Word or phrase for the tendered use, matched in the tender's permitted uses, e.g. childcare, hostel, school, storage, nursery, office. Leave out for all awards. Singapore: a word from the tendered uses, e.g. childcare, hostel, school…

years.description: How many award years to include, counted back from the newest year in the file. Default 10. Singapore: award years to include, counted back from the newest year in the file (2025). Default 10.

name: pricepaid_state_property_rents

outputSchema.description: Price range from real records: price, sample_size, period, confidence, source and licence.

summary.description: One sentence an AI can quote.
